title: Avatar hub
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Criar GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 120)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.1, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = screenGui

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.6, 0)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
button.Text = "Avatar Completo"
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
button.Parent = frame

-- Função para aplicar avatar completo
local function applyAvatar()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

    -- Limpar roupas e acessórios antigos
    for _, item in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("Accessory") then
            item:Destroy()
        end
    end

    -- CAMISA
    local shirt = Instance.new("Shirt")
    shirt.ShirtTemplate = "rbxassetid://144076760"
    shirt.Parent = character

    -- CALÇA
    local pants = Instance.new("Pants")
    pants.PantsTemplate = "rbxassetid://144076759"
    pants.Parent = character

    -- ROSTO
    local head = character:WaitForChild("Head")
    local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
    if face then
        face.Texture = "rbxassetid://7074764"
    end

    -- CABELO
    local hair = Instance.new("Accessory")
    hair.Name = "CoolHair"

    local handle = Instance.new("Part")
    handle.Name = "Handle"
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
    handle.Parent = hair

    local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
    mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://62234425"
    mesh.TextureId = "rbxassetid://62234536"
    mesh.Parent = handle

    hair.Parent = character

    -- COR DO CORPO
    for _, part in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
        end
    end
end

button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(applyAvatar)
